name: inspira-glare-card
blurb: 3D card with pointer-tracked glare and background shift.
description: A card with state-driven pointer tracking that updates glare position, background shifts, and 3D rotation. CSS variables drive the visual transformation.
use_when: Premium, interactive cards or hero showcases where 3D depth and glare effects create tactile, high-end aesthetics.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where pointer tracking won't work or low-motion contexts where 3D rotations should be disabled.
a11y: Card is a container; children are independent. 3D effects and pointer tracking are visual embellishment. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
